sentences.text: This application for bail has been filed by applicant Firoz Khan seeking his enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 211 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Act, Police Station- Baniather, District Sambhal, during the pendency of trial.
At the very outset, learned A.G.A. contends that marriage of applicant was solemnized with deceased on 28.6.2021.
However, just after expiry of period of one year and two months, the wife of applicant committed suicide on 19.8.2022 in her marital home.
